description: Java class XmlWidgetConditionVisitor that generates XML from widget model conditions, implementing the ModelConditionVisitor interface and extending XmlAbstractWidgetVisitor.

classes.name: XmlWidgetConditionVisitor
classes.description: A visitor class that generates XML from widget model conditions.

methods.name: visit(And and)
methods.description: Generates XML for 'and' condition, visiting subconditions.

methods.name: visit(IfCompare ifCompare)
methods.description: Generates XML for 'if-compare' condition with attributes.

methods.description: Generates XML for 'if-compare-field' condition with attributes.

methods.name: visit(IfHasPermission ifHasPermission)
methods.description: Generates XML for 'if-has-permission' condition with attributes.

methods.name: visit(IfRegexp ifRegexp)
methods.description: Generates XML for 'if-regexp' condition with attributes.

methods.name: visit(ModelMenuCondition modelMenuCondition)
methods.description: Generates XML for 'ModelMenuCondition' and its nested condition.

methods.description: Generates XML for 'ModelTreeCondition' and its nested condition.
